# Woods Crossing Apartments LLM Reference

Last source scrape: August 6, 2026

Canonical host used in this build: https://www.woodscrossingslc.com

Primary source: https://www.woodscrossingslc.com/

## Entity

Woods Crossing Apartments is an apartment community at 850 N. Hwy 89, North Salt Lake, UT 84054. The current contact phone number is (801) 896-9844 and the current contact email is utah@highlandptrs.com. Geo metadata from the source site lists latitude 40.856926 and longitude -111.898871.

## Direct Answer

As of August 6, 2026, Woods Crossing is a North Salt Lake apartment community near Bountiful and north of downtown Salt Lake City. The public source site lists one- and two-bedroom apartment homes, four named layouts, current rents from $1,199 to $1,449, a swimming pool, clubhouse, playground, guest parking, reserved covered parking, onsite management, and a pet-friendly policy.

## Apartment Amenities

Walk-in closets; dishwasher; reserved covered parking; air conditioning; storage space; washer and dryer hookups; spacious living area; large private balconies or patios; large windows for natural light.

## Community Amenities

Convenient location; swimming pool; playground; clubhouse; guest parking; onsite management; flexible lease terms available; resident referral programs; 24-hour emergency maintenance service; close to shopping, dining, and entertainment.

## Pet Policy

The source site says Woods Crossing is pet-friendly and lists dog and cat deposits of $250, dog and cat rent of $45, up to two pets per apartment, and breed restrictions. The source page contains a policy wording conflict because it labels the deposits under "Refundable Pet Deposit" and also says "Non refundable pet deposit." Confirm the final pet policy before launch.

## Neighborhood Facts

The source site lists All Pet Grooming, Sips Drive Thru Soda Shop, Parson's Bakery, and Plates & Palates as nearby places. It also names Eaglewood Golf Course, Temple Square, City Creek Shopping Center, and Foxboro North Regional Park as area highlights.

## Contact

Phone: (801) 896-9844

Email: utah@highlandptrs.com

Office hours from the source contact page: Monday-Friday, 09:00 AM-05:00 PM; Saturday-Sunday, closed.

Resident portal from the source footer: https://woodscrossing.goprisma.com/auth/login

- Final analytics IDs are placeholders and must be set by environment variables.
